An exhaustive 27-case local Euler identity, with source and recorded output included, yields rank abc; every unit cube carries an S³ fundamental cycle detected primitively by a globally maximal parity tetrahedron, furnishing exactly abc independent generators. A direct grid-filling argument proves simple connectivity and the homological Whitehead theorem proves the wedge. Filtered union and explicit 16-simplex chain transformations give the stated integral lattice-isometry module; all 48 local cube symmetries were checked.

originality.rationale: The primary 2025 paper proves degree-three concentration but explicitly leaves the finite equal-cube multiplicity as ν_M with only a lower bound. This result computes abc for all rectangular boxes, a canonical primitive local basis, and the full integral symmetry action. Primary full-text mathematical implications, nearby published records and accessible ledger claims were compared; none supplied the claimed rank-and-basis theorem. Remaining risk is unindexed or differently formulated coverage.
residual_risks: An unindexed or newly posted 2026 paper may independently compute identical rectangular-box sphere ranks.
General cellular algebra or unpublished notes under a different cubical-topology terminology could contain an equivalent basis.

value.rationale: The natural parameter abc counts lattice unit cells in the finite exhaustion of Z³ and exactly fills a finite multiplicity left undetermined by the motivating integer-lattice theorem. The primitive integral basis and signed crystallographic symmetry action are structural refinements useful for persistence through nested boxes and equivariant homology, not a merely reworded known wedge equivalence.
